citations.reference: Tosafot Yom Tov on Mishnah Shekalim 5:1:6
citations.assessment: The Temple roster and Tosafot Yom Tov attest the name and assignment. The Yerushalmi version has Hugdas, and Tosafot Yom Tov cites the interpretation “of the Levites” for ben Levi. The English retains Heilprin’s explicit “his son.”
